text:
The bug is in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`, primarily `TTLCache.expire()`.

`TTLCache` consistently treats an item as expired when `time >= link.expires` in membership, lookup, and iteration (`not (time < expires)` / `time < expires`). However, `expire()` removes entries only while `time > curr.expires`, so an entry exactly at its expiration time remains counted by `len()` and `currsize`, while other views hide it.

I intend to change the expiration loop condition in `TTLCache.expire()` from `time > curr.expires` to `time >= curr.expires`, aligning cleanup with the existing expiration semantics.
